notes.title: Welcome to Hanwell is being made free!
notes.notes:
It has been over 7 years since we released Welcome to Hanwell, and to celebrate the launch of it's sequel, Beyond Hanwell, Welcome to Hanwell is being made free to everyone, forever.

This decision has been made to remove any barrier to anybody that wants to explore the Hanwell universe more deeply, Beyond Hanwell is a standalone game, and does not require you to play Welcome to Hanwell, but there are many references and lots of lore that can be expanded by playing the first game before (or after) diving into Beyond Hanwell.

To all who paid and supported us by paying for and playing Welcome to Hanwell, I cannot thank you enough, without you Beyond Hanwell would not exist, and I'm currently in talks with Valve to figure out exactly how you can be rewarded for being there before this moment. Keep an eye on our announcement feed for more on this later.

Welcome to Hanwell should switch from paid to free sometime today, if not today then tomorrow, depending on how quickly valve action my request.

Thank you,
Nathan

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28214327/4c925ef1ac538bcf578aa90f07af51bd92ff1778.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28214327/a40eda323362f96935d729914880dbb81ac6e08c.jpg[/img][/url]

Hi guys!

I'd like to announce [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/816330/The_Council_of_Hanwell]The Council of Hanwell[/url], a condensed horror experience consisting of the major locations from Welcome to Hanwell in a linear story driven package.

In addition to the main story from Welcome to Hanwell you'll get 3 new game modes:
[list]
[*]Survival, a wave based survival mini game.

[*]Escape, an incredibly tense stealth mode in which you must avoid The Brute and escape from different scenarios.

[*]Prototype, a bonus map of the very earliest gameplay from Welcome to Hanwell.

[*]Plus a graphical overhaul adding new effects such as Volumetric Fog and new 4K environmental textures and character skins.
[/list]

Best of all, anyone that bought Welcome to Hanwell before The Council of Hanwell's release will receive a copy of The Council of Hanwell [b]absolutely free![/b]

Thanks for the amazing support!

Nathan

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.6
notes.notes:
We just put out a hotfix to address some issues with keybinding.

The Axis Rebind menu option has been removed and we have bound the arrow keys to character movement along with WASD. So you can now play with WASD or arrowkeys and rebind all other actions from the key rebind menu.

This will be of particular benefit to left handed players.

Thanks,

Nathan

notes.title: Update 1.3! Third Person View Mode!
notes.notes:
We just rolled out update 1.3!

[h1]Third Person View Mode[/h1]
Update 1.3 adds the ability to play the entire game in third person, simply press the "Z" key (or "Right D-Pad" on controllers) to toggle between first and third person.

It's important to note the game was designed from scratch with first person in mind, so we still recommend playing in FP to experience the game how it was imagined. But we added the feature due to community request and it's a great addition for players who prefer third person games!

You may occasionally encounter minor bugs in third person while we iron them out, if this happens simply switch to first person, do what you were trying to do and switch back, we'd really appreciate a report on here too! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Added a third person view mode![/b]
[*]Added a temporary FOV change switch (press "Num +" to switch between 90, 100, 110, 120).
[*]Added a new location.
[*]Re-Painted the player model with completely new 4K PBR materials.
[*]Added UHD and 4K resolutions (These are untested and should be considered a beta feature!)
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a never ending storm.
[/list]

As always we love to hear what you think!

Thanks,

Nathan

notes.title: Update 1.2.6
notes.notes:
Hey!

We just uploaded the latest update, adding resolution options and refining combat when going up against a Witch!

[list]
[*]Added a resolution option to the settings menu in the Main Menu.
[*]Refined combat when fighting a witch to make it more responsive and feel like you actually landed the hit.
[*]Stopped all spawned actors from ticking unless essential, this is to further optimize performance.
[/list]

[b]EDIT: You can now invert your mouse in the ingame menu, I didn't think this tiny update was worth a new announcement.[/b]

I included the most common screen resolutions, if you think there should be more or need a specific option, please let me know and I'll look into it.

I'm also interested in testing 4K or UHD resolutions but don't have a display to test this on. If anybody would like to help let me know and I'll deploy a build with 4K options to the beta branch. (Although if you're display is 4K native it's possible the game would automatically run in 4K anyway)

Look out for the next update, I'm working on some experimental features including a third person view mode, a combat overhaul and looking into more exterior content, such as procedural objectives,  comment here if you have any requests or would like to discuss anything. 

Thanks!

Nathan

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.1
notes.notes:
I had a report today from someone who experienced a particular nasty bug that corrupted their game and would loop back to the Main Menu when trying to continue. It was caused by a checkpoint in the Council building before leaving the game twice and returning after the boss fight.

[h1]This issue has now been fixed![/h1]

I also implemented a failsafe for anyone that has experienced this bug, if you were affected and you get the scenario described above. Your save will now work fine, keeping your progress and items but will spit you into the Main World instead of The Council.

Thanks!

Nathan

notes.notes:
Thanks for the feedback guys. Here's a list of the latest fixes/changes:

[list]
[*]There are now 60% less bombs in Hanwell, they seemed to be getting annoying for most players and so you are now less likely to run into them.
[*]Enemies will present themselves much more frequently.
[*]Weapons are now much less likely to cluster.
[*]Saving your game at an ATM will now act as a true checkpoint, we recommend you use them too since more enemies means more death.
[/list]

Thanks to you all for your support. Expect more to come including new content for Halloween!

Nathan

An early demo of the game is still available, you can download it here:

[url=https://nathanseedhouse.itch.io/welcome-to-hanwell-]Welcome to Hanwell Demo on Itch.io[/url]

It's a very early demo and is already out of date, a lot of features have been added or refined. But it's still worth a look if your interested in the game.
